title: ControlsBench recording 0.1 (DRAFT, not implemented)
description: Reserved contract for a future passive recording of ST_CB_ObservationFrame publications. No writer, reader or recording exists. Gate G-REC-1 must freeze this format with executed tests before any tool depends on it.

machineMap.description: Copied from the generated manifest so raw values stay interpretable without the PLC

source.description: PLC library build identity and the transport binding that produced the samples

qualification.description: Reference to the measurement that qualified this rate for this process and transport, or 'unqualified'

sourceTime.const: PLC platform monotonic microseconds of the session cycle (SourceTimeUs)

receiptTime.description: Workstation monotonic and wall clocks used for receipt timestamps

alignment.description: Declared uncertainty; no cross-task or cross-domain simultaneity

authority.description: Recording is passive: it records SimApplied and suppression from each frame and holds no write capability

quality.description: SimApplied, ConnectorStale, ConfigValid, ClockValid, ReconfigureRequired, AnySuppressed and transport status

frame.description: Raw values exactly as published; never scaled, filtered or interpolated

method.description: Any interpolated, resampled or scaled value is labelled here and never replaces a raw record
